{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "---
name: CI build and test
# Schema: https://json.schemastore.org/github-action.json

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      container:
        type: boolean
        description: "Running in docker container"
        default: false
      os:
        type: string
        description: "The operating system of the runner"
        default: 'ubuntu-24.04'  # Default used for container
      gcc:
        type: string
        description: "The GCC version to use"
        required: true
      python-version:
        type: string
        description: "The Python version to use"
        required: false  # Only needed if not in container
      upload-app:
        type: boolean
        description: 'Upload the standalone application'
        default: false
      tag:
        type: string
        description: "The tag to apply"
        required: true
      tag_message:
        type: string
        description: "The tag message to use"
        required: true

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  gcovr-ci-job:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.container && 'ubuntu-24.04' || inputs.os }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      SPHINX_SKIP_CHECK_LINKS: "True"
      FORCE_COLOR: "1"
      NOX_CONTAINER_ARGUMENTS: >-
        ${{ inputs.container && format(' --session docker_run_compiler({0}) --', inputs.gcc) || '' }}
      GENERATE_DOCUMENTATION: >-
        ${{ inputs.container && contains(fromJSON('["gcc-5", "gcc-6", "gcc-7", "gcc-8", "gcc-9", "clang-10"]'), inputs.gcc) }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 75
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Prepare package version
        uses: "$/.github/actions/prepare-package-version"
        with:
          tag: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          tag_message: ${{ inputs.tag_message }}

      - name: Set up runner
        uses: "$/.github/actions/setup-runner"
        with:
          os: ${{ inputs.os }}
          gcc: ${{ (!inputs.container && inputs.gcc) || '' }}
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Set up environment
        run: |
          # Enable coverage for specific target configurations
          if [ "${{ inputs.container }}" == "true" ] ; then
            case "${INPUTS_GCC}" in
              gcc-5)    USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              gcc-8)    USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              gcc-14)   USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              gcc-15)   USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              clang-10) USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              clang-20) USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              *)        USE_COVERAGE=false ;;
            esac
          else
            case "${INPUTS_OS}/${INPUTS_GCC}/${INPUTS_PYTHON_VERSION}" in
              ubuntu-24.04/gcc-11/3.14) USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              windows-2025/gcc/3.14)    USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              macos-15/gcc/3.10)        USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              macos-26/gcc-15/3.14)     USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              *)                        USE_COVERAGE=false ;;
            esac
          fi
          echo "USE_COVERAGE=$USE_COVERAGE" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          # Set the CC environment
          echo "CC=${INPUTS_GCC}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        env:
          INPUTS_GCC: ${{ inputs.gcc }}
          INPUTS_OS: ${{ inputs.os }}
          INPUTS_PYTHON_VERSION: ${{ inputs.python-version }}

      - name: Expose GitHub Runtime for Docker cache
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-github-runtime@04d248b84655b509d8c44dc1d6f990c879747487  # v4.0.0

      - name: Build Docker
        if: ${{ inputs.container }}
        run: |
          nox --non-interactive --session "docker_build_compiler(${INPUTS_GCC})"
        env:
          INPUTS_GCC: ${{ inputs.gcc }}

      - name: Lint files
        run: |
          nox --non-interactive $NOX_CONTAINER_ARGUMENTS --session lint

      - name: Test with pytest
        run: |
          nox --non-interactive $NOX_CONTAINER_ARGUMENTS --session tests --  --archive-differences
          # There must not be any modifications to get the correct versions later
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ] ; then
            git status
            git diff
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Upload pytest test results
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: >-
            diffs-${{
              inputs.container && format('docker-{0}', inputs.gcc)
              || format('{0}-{1}-{2}', inputs.os, inputs.gcc, inputs.python-version)
            }}
          path: tests/diff.zip

      - name: Upload coverage
        if: ${{ env.USE_COVERAGE == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: >-
            coverage-pytest-${{
              inputs.container && format('docker-{0}', inputs.gcc)
              || format('{0}-{1}-{2}', inputs.os, inputs.gcc, inputs.python-version)
            }}
          path: .coverage_*
          include-hidden-files: true

      - name: Generate documentation
        if: ${{ env.GENERATE_DOCUMENTATION == 'true' }}
        run: |
          nox --non-interactive $NOX_CONTAINER_ARGUMENTS --session doc || exit 1

          # Check if files are modified (outdated screenshots)
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ] ; then
            git diff

            echo "Please regenerate the screenshots!"
            exit 1
          fi
          exit 0

      - name: Build and check the wheel
        run: |
          nox --non-interactive $NOX_CONTAINER_ARGUMENTS --session build_distribution

      - name: Build and check standalone application
        if: ${{ !startsWith(inputs.python-version,'pypy') }}
        run: |
          nox --non-interactive $NOX_CONTAINER_ARGUMENTS --session bundle_app

      - name: Upload app bundle artifacts
        if: ${{ inputs.upload-app == true }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: app-${{ inputs.os }}
          path: build/gcovr*",
  "rationale": "Add a pip dependency cache (actions/cache@v4) keyed on pyproject.toml, placed after the runner/Python setup and before the nox install/test steps. The repository ships pyproject.toml and the job installs Python dependencies via nox on every run, so caching ~/.cache/pip avoids re-downloading wheels across reruns without changing any build or test step. This mirrors the measured experiment evidence that adds the same pip cache step to a test workflow (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE). All existing steps, permissions (contents: read), and required checks are preserved; no privileges, secrets, deployment/publishing, or new network access are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
